title: Common providers: Czechia
coverage: Complete for the three mobile network operators (all sell fixed lines) and the national wholesale network; cable, fibre and business ISPs are partial, and local wireless ISPs are not listed.
missing: Local wireless and fibre ISPs (well over a thousand are registered)
An AS number for České Radiokomunikace (none found)
AS5588 of T-Mobile Czech Republic (registered to it and not announced on the read date)
A website for CESNET (it answered an automated request only with a refusal or a bot check on the read date)

sources.name: ČTÚ (Czech Telecommunication Office): register of undertakings in electronic communications
sources.terms: The page was requested on the read date; its reuse terms were not read (they are in the national language), so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in the Czech Republic
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 11 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in the Czech Republic
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 3 of 11 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 10 of 11 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty. No support or status page was checked. An address that answered only with a refusal, a bot check or a page-not-found page counts as one that did not answer.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 11 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number whose holder was another company is listed only where the note says whose it is.

sources.name: RIPE Database (RIPE NCC): organisation and aut-num objects
sources.terms: The RIPE Database terms were not re-read for this pack; it is treated like RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to find which AS numbers an organisation holds.
sources.result: Read to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikipedia: CETIN
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: the network of O2 Czech Republic was split off as CETIN on 1 June 2015; CETIN sells wholesale to O2, T-Mobile and Vodafone.

sources.name: Wikipedia: O2 Czech Republic; Vodafone Czech Republic
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Cited for names and dates (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above for former names: Český Telecom and Eurotel (O2), Oskar (Vodafone).

providers.name: O2 Czech Republic
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile, retail; the lines run on CETIN's network.

providers.name: T-Mobile Czech Republic

providers.name: CETIN
